_about: The three flight tools, as docs/grok-flight-mcp.md defines them. flight-mcp serves these definitions, and the Next.js route sends the first two as function tools when no flight server is configured. One file, so the two sides cannot drift.

tools.name: validate_oem
tools.description: Validate a CCSDS OEM 3.0 KVN trajectory against the 3rok profile. Returns errors. Does not store the file.

oem.description: Full OEM keyword-value text, including the version header.

tools.name: submit_oem
tools.description: Validate an OEM and, if it passes, hold it as the candidate trajectory for this request. Does not publish it and does not see holdout data.

tools.name: score_candidate
tools.description: Score one reduced LEO orbit for chip lifetime, mean power, radiator area, and shield mass. Refuses orbits outside 500–2000 km and outside inclination 30 degrees or sun-synchronous. Does not propagate a trajectory.
